 For usage and more details, please visit the app’s project page.
¹ quoting from the Wikipedia article:
 Secure Socket Tunneling Protocol (SSTP) is a form of virtual private network (VPN) tunnel that provides a mechanism to transport PPP traffic through an SSL/TLS channel. fdroid:barilyuk.batterytemperature.name: BatteryTemperatureDisplay
fdroid:barilyuk.batterytemperature.summary: Temperature monitor and logging to prevent overheating, damage, and safety risks
fdroid:barilyuk.batterytemperature.description:
BatteryTemperatureDisplay shows Android phone’s real-time battery temperature. The information is always visible in an icon in the status bar and in a notification, even while you use other apps.
Practical uses of monitoring battery temperature:
 🔥 Overheating detection during gaming or charging
 Li-ion battery degrades and loses its capacity when heated over 40 degrees Celsius for prolonged time. This can happen during gaming, 4K video recording, wireless charging. Set alarm to immediately get notified before battery gets actually overheated.
 🧩 Prevent solder cracks under phone's processor
 Battery is the main channel for phone's process to dumpits heat. When your battery gets over 40 degrees Celsius under heavy load of gaming or video recording, phone processor is melting itself at that moment. Repeated cycles of processor overheating cause its solder to crack, leading to phone unable to boot and work.
 ⚠Reduce risk of phone li-ion battery fire
 Reaching 50 degrees Celsius may lead to li-ion thermal runaway and fire. Set an alarm to get alerted before your battery reaches this dangerous threshold. That is especially valuable if you leave your phone charging overnight, alowing to avoid cases of phone getting on fire while everyone in the house sleeps.
 📊Use old Android as temperature logger
 Repurpose your old smartphone as temperature logging device to track the environment in your home, 🌱 greenhouse or 🐕 animal barn. Temperature fluctuations affect plant and animal health before they show visual stress signs. Log temperature for any time range - set if for minutes, hours, days, months. Temperature log is produced in timestamped CSV format, allowing for easy analysis in Excel, Google Sheets or any other spreadsheet editor.
 🏃Heat stroke prevention
 During outdoor work or sports, let your phone to work as a body temperature monitor. If your phone reaches +40 °C in your pocket, you're in conditions that can cause heat exhaustion.
 ❄Body heat conservation
 Avoid excessive heat loss in cold weather. Phone placed against body shows how effectively your clothing retains heat during cold emergencies.
 🚗Hot car safety
 Phone temperature rise in parked car indicates when interior becomes dangerous for children or pets - provides quantified warning beyond "it feels hot."
 🥶Food safety monitoring 
 Place your phone in a cooler during camping or power outages to know your food is safe. If the battery temperature rises above +4 °C, your food is entering the danger zone for bacterial growth.
 🛏Bed assessment 
 Place your phone between bed sheets and launch temperature logging. The log may highlight your bedding retains too much heat, affecting sleep quality and suggesting bed sheets material changes.
 🏠Know heat insulation problems
 Phone temperature varying dramatically in different parts of your house reveals insulation issues. Rooms with poor insulation will cause your phone to heat up or cool down faster.
 🌡Poor man's thermometer
 Track ambient temperature of any room with your phone if no dedicated thermometer is available.
The Android Battery Temperature app is a tool for anyone who wants to monitor, log, and act on temperature data using nothing more than your own smartphone. The app can be both a safety instrument and a multi-purpose temperature monitoring solution.
Created by Eugen Barilyuk EB43 https://eb43.github.io

fdroid:com.guiforge.bati.name: Bati: Fitness RPG
fdroid:com.guiforge.bati.summary: Turn workouts into quests, boss fights and a village built by your training.
fdroid:com.guiforge.bati.description:
Train like a hero, build like a king.
Bati turns strength training into a dark-fantasy RPG. A workout is a quest. Reps land as damage on a boss. The muscles you actually work raise the buildings of a village that grows out of what you lifted, not out of what you bought.
SPORT FIRST, RPG SECOND
The training logic leads and the game amplifies it. Nothing decorative gets between you and your next set: large tap targets, high-contrast text, and a screen designed for one hand in a noisy gym.
WHAT YOU GET
• Quests: guided sessions with targets that adapt to your level
• Adventures: multi-session campaigns with a story between steps
• Boss fights: reps become damage; weaknesses and criticals make the numbers mean something
• Outings: walk, run or ride; the ground you cover raises the road out of the village
• A village: buildings level up from the volume you actually logged
• Oaths: pick one goal and let the app hold you to it
• Reminders: on the days you choose, scheduled on the phone, no server
• Backups: as a file, or automatic into a folder you pick, encrypted if you ask
• Sync: one hero across several phones
• Health Connect, off by default: Bati writes your sessions and outings there, with their distance, the GPS route only if you ask, and reads nothing
• Six languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Russian, Chinese
• A journal: history, records, your flame, muscle balance
YOUR TRAINING STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
No account. No sign-up. No server of ours. No analytics, no ads, no tracking of any kind. Your sessions, your records and the GPS trace of an outing live in a database on your device. Your phone's own system backup can carry it, like any app's data, and you can turn that off. Uninstalling the app deletes it from the phone, not the copies you made elsewhere.
Three features use the network, each behind its own switch in Settings, and all three start off:
• The map behind an outing's route. The phone asks OpenFreeMap (OpenStreetMap data, from tiles.openfreemap.org) for tiles, the square images a map is made of, around where you go. That tells the host roughly where you were, with your IP address and the time. Off, the route is drawn on a plain background.
• Check for updates. Once a day, the app asks api.github.com whether a newer version exists. No identifier is sent, nothing is downloaded.
• Device sync. Your history, encrypted on the phone (AES-256-GCM), goes to a WebDAV or Nextcloud server you choose, which cannot read it. Or into a folder that Syncthing keeps in step, and Bati makes no request at all.
With all three off, the app makes no network request. Only two files in the code may make one from JavaScript, and a lint rule rejects any other before it ships.
Location is read only while an outing is running, by a GPS module written for this app against Android's own location service. No Google Play Services, no third-party SDK, nothing that phones home.
BODYWEIGHT FIRST
The exercise catalogue is built around what you can do with no equipment, and adapts if you own some. Warm-ups are dynamic and scaled to the session in front of you.
NOT A MEDICAL DEVICE
Bati is a training app. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition. If you have an injury, a health condition or doubts about exercising, talk to a doctor before you start.
Open source: https://github.com/Guiforge/bati

fdroid:com.one37view.camescape.name: CamEscape
fdroid:com.one37view.camescape.summary: Map surveillance cameras from OpenStreetMap and plan routes that avoid them
fdroid:com.one37view.camescape.description:
CamEscape maps surveillance cameras recorded in OpenStreetMap and plans walking, cycling or driving routes that avoid them.
 Features 
 Camera-aware routing: routes that steer clear of cameras, with clear (green) and watched (red) segments
 Adjustable avoidance strength
 Field of view: cones for fixed cameras when their direction is mapped, coverage zones for dome cameras
 Walking, cycling and driving modes
 Live mode that follows your position and warns when a camera on the route cannot be avoided or the route hits a dead end
 Cameras downloaded per country in a few seconds and stored on the device (SQLite), viewable offline; map tiles you have already seen are cached
 Light/dark theme, English and French, metric/imperial units
 Privacy 
No account, no analytics, no ads, no identifier sent. A country's cameras are downloaded from a file hosted on GitLab Pages, which receives your IP address and the requested country. Your position is sent without any identifier to OpenStreetMap's Nominatim to suggest your country, and, in live mode, an area around you is sent to a public Overpass instance to fetch nearby roads. Route bounding boxes also go to Overpass. Overpass instances are run by independent operators and receive your IP address.
Route planning and live mode require a connection. Camera data is community-mapped and may be incomplete: CamEscape is a planning aid, not a guarantee of being unobserved. Missing cameras can be added to OpenStreetMap (man_made=surveillance).

fdroid:com.phpbg.easysync.name: EasySync
fdroid:com.phpbg.easysync.summary: Synchronize your phone with your WebDAV server, the easy way.
fdroid:com.phpbg.easysync.description:
Synchronize images, videos, audio and downloads with your WebDAV server.
Synchronize in both directions.
Secure and open source.
What is synchronized:
* Images, video, screenshots that are displayed in your gallery will be synchronized. This includes images and videos in `DCIM/`, `Pictures/`, `Movies/` and `Download/`
* If they are only available in a specific app but not in gallery, they won't be synchronized
* Please note that messaging apps (messages, whatsapp, signal, etc.) generally offer you the choice between saving files in your gallery (in such case they will be synchronized) or not
* All audio and music files that are visible in `Alarms/`, `Audiobooks/`, `Music/`, `Notifications/`, `Podcasts/`, `Ringtones/` and `Recordings/` will be synchronized
* Beware that google's own voice recorder stores its files privately and offer its own cloud synchronization. They won't be synchronized by EasySync
* All downloaded files in `Download/` will be synchronized, whether they are pdf, epubs, documents, images, etc.
What is not synchronized:
Everything not explicitly stated above is not synchronized. More specifically:
* Applications
* Applications data/state
* Messages
* Contacts
* Games progress
* Wifi or network parameters
* Android settings and phone customization
Files on **SD Card** are **NOT** synced

fdroid:dev.lorsupra.tabi.description:
TABI takes you from your first hiragana to reading a menu, counting change, understanding the konbini clerk, reading street signs, and picking the right train. It has eleven stations, unlocked in order, each with two trials and a test from the Stationmaster (駅長). Pass it and the station's eki stamp goes in your stamp book. SHARE STAMP turns any stamp into an image for Mastodon or any other app.
A day takes about five minutes. One button shows you up to eight new items, then asks about twenty questions from everything you have met so far. Finishing it marks the day, whatever your score. There are no streaks. Missed days cost nothing and nothing decays while you are away.
What the stations cover:
• Hiragana and katakana, with a mnemonic for every character, a deck to read them all without a quiz, and drills aimed at the look-alikes
• Numbers, prices, clock times, and counting people versus things
• Thirty survival phrases and the situations they belong to
• Ordering food, reading menus, and the questions every register clerk asks
• Fifty-eight sign kanji: exits, toilets, push and pull, open and closed, no photos, hot and cold
• Platform boards, train types, IC cards, and following spoken directions
• Particles and sentence building
• A listening log for hours of Japanese heard
• The first 104 kanji
Question types: multiple choice, typed answers in romaji (IME spellings accepted) or kana, listening, matching, tile building, and rendered menus and platform boards. Wrong answers show the rule you missed.
Audio uses the Japanese voice from your phone's text-to-speech engine. With one installed, some questions play the sound first and show the text after you answer. Hold a speaker button to hear a line slower. If none is installed, the app tells you how to add one. Every reading is printed, so nothing depends on audio.
TABI requests no INTERNET permission. Progress stays on the device and backs up to a file or as text.

flathub:io.github.dzheremi2.lrcmake-gtk.description:
Chronograph is an open-source application designed for accurately syncing lyrics 
 with audio timestamps.
 You may notice that many of music players support synced lyrics which are 
 highlighted line-by-line or word-by-word while playing? This app was designed to 
 give the community an ability to be the ones who make these lyrics.

 use LRCLib to fetch synchronized lyrics, this integration allows users to easily 
 contribute their work back to the open-source community.

 Chronograph also supports mass lyrics downloading. It will try to find lyrics for each 
 of your track on LRClib and save it depending on your settings.

 Line-by-Line (Primary): Here, every time you do sync action, timestamp is placed 
 for the whole line of lyrics. This is the most supported format of synced lyrics.
 Word-by-Word (Advanced): Designed for true karaoke quality. It places a 
 timestamp for every single word, enabling players to animate lyrics with precision.
 Supported Formats

 FLAC
 MP3
 M4A
 OPUS
 WAV
 AAC (reduced functionality)

fedora-packages:ghc-bitwise/ghc-bitwise.description: Unboxed multidimensional bit packed Bool arrays with fast aggregate operations based on lifting Bool operations to bitwise operations. There are many other bit packed structures out there, but none met all of these requirements: (1) unboxed bit packed Bool array, (2) multi-dimensional indexing, (3) fast (de)serialization, or interoperable with foreign code, (4) fast aggregate operations (fold, map, zip). Quick tour of the bitwise library: [Data.Bits.Bitwise] Lift boolean operations on 'Bool' to bitwise operations on 'Data.Bits.Bits'. [Data.Array.BitArray] Immutable bit arrays. [Data.Array.BitArray.ST] Mutable bit arrays in 'Control.Monad.ST.ST'. [Data.Array.BitArray.IO] Mutable bit arrays in 'IO'. [Data.Array.BitArray.ByteString] (De)serialization. [Codec.Image.PBM] Portable bitmap monochrome 2D image format. Very rough performance benchmarks: * immutable random access single bit reads: 'BitArray ix' is about 40% slower than 'UArray ix Bool', * 'Control.Monad.ST.ST' mutable random access single bit reads: 'STBitArray s ix' is about the same as 'STUArray s ix Bool', * immutable map 'Bool -> Bool': 'BitArray ix' is about 85x faster than 'UArray ix Bool', * immutable zipWith 'Bool -> Bool -> Bool': 'BitArray ix' is about 1300x faster than 'UArray ix Bool'.

A Firefox Add-on (port of Google Chrome Extension) for sending online content to be played on XBMC/Kodi.  Requirements: 
 XBMC/Kodi Eden (v11) or later
 YouTube, DailyMotion, CollegeHumor, eBaumsWorld, Twitch.TV , Hulu, SoundCloud or MixCloud plugins installed on Kodi
 For Hulu, you'll need a plugin from a third party repository 
 YouTube plugin must be version 4.4.4 or later
 How to use: 
 "Play now" button sends the currently playing video of your active tab to Kodi. If there are videos currently in a queue, it would be cleared and the current video would be played
 "+Queue (X)" button puts the video of your current tab to the end of the playlist on Kodi. A number in parenthesis shows the number of items currently in the queue
 "+Favourite" button keeps the video of your current tab in your favourite list for easy access
 Drag and drop your favourites to rearrange them
 With the extension window open, you can use some of your keyboard keys to remotely control Kodi. These keys are: Arrow keys, Backspace, Enter, "I" and "C"
 Right click on YouTube links to play or queue
 Permissions: 
 Your data on all websites: Needed so that the extension could send JSON requests to any URL that you might put in the settings
 Your tabs and browsing activity: Used only for getting the URL of the current tab so that we could use it to obtain the video id for sending to Kodi

 On Kodi, go under System > Settings > Services > Webserver
 Enable "Allow control of Kodi via HTTP, leave the port as default or set it to something else (if you know what you're doing). Write down the port number
 Username and password are optional
 Right click on the 'Play to Kodi' icon and select 'Options'
 Put in the IP address or hostname of your Kodi box and fill in the port number with the port number you wrote down earlier. Fill in the username and password if you entered one into Kodi
 Visit YouTube, watch some videos and click on the 'Play to Kodi' icon to play them on Kodi

 Not all CollegeHumor videos play correctly. This is a problem with the CollegeHumor plugin on Kodi itself.
 SoundCloud content can't small skip forward. This is a problem with the SoundCloud plugin on Kodi.
 For Twitch.tv , only live streams can be played

Easily Download YouTube Videos in MP4, WEBM, M4a and more in FHD quality with sound.
All resolutions and qualities (720p, 1080p, UHD, 60FPS, HDR, 2K, 4K, 8K) are supported for both muted videos & videos with sound.
Download ultra HD qualities like (1080p, 2K, 4K, 8K) with audio in one click without the need to install any alternative plugins or apps.
Features:
- Download higher resolutions like (1080p, 2K, 4K, 8K) in one click.
- Download unlisted, private & restricted YouTube videos easily in 1 click.
- Download Youtube as audio files in formats (MP3, WebM, M4A).
- Download videos from YouTube withut the background sound or music if you need to.
- Download YouTube videos with different options like (30FPS, 60FPS, HDR).
- Download Manifest YouTube links and convert to sound MP3.
- Simple Download button with fancy UI menu with different download options.
- Does not require any additional settings.
How it works ?
A simple green button is added to YouTube video pages, which enables you to download videos.
The button is integrated in a simple manner below the video and next to other YouTube buttons (see screenshots).
Click the button to populate a list of available formats to download and choose the one you want.
(You don't need to run or use any other apps to download FHD videos with sound, the Add-on will handle everything for you to download videos in one click)
Download options
These are the most popular video formats and qualities available:
- MP4 / WEBM 8K - 4320p
- MP4 / WEBM 4K - 2160p
- MP4 / WEBM 2K - 1440p
- MP4 / WEBM 1080p
- MP4 / WEBM 720p
- MP4 / WEBM 480p
- MP4 / WEBM 360p
- MP4 / WEBM 240p
- MP4 / WEBM 144p
These are the audio formats and qualities available:
- OPUS 160k / 64k / 48k
- AAC 128k
- VORBIS 128k
Important - How to report bugs
If you find any issue or bugs, please feel free to send an email to "support@youtube4kdownloader.com", rather than just give bad reviews with the issue mentioned there :(
And we'll do much effort to reply and solve this issue ASAP.
How to watch downloaded videos?
After downloading videos, you can play them using some of these free apps (or similar to these):
- VLC - Windows/Mac/Linux - very popular
- Movies & TV - pre installed on Windows 10
- Windows Media Player Windows Media Player 12 - Windows
- iTunes - Windows/Mac

firefox-addons:2935935.name: Quick Access
firefox-addons:2935935.summary: A clean, intuitive new tab page where you can access your Top Sites, Favorites, and Tab Groups with just one click.
firefox-addons:2935935.description:
A clean, intuitive new tab page where you can access your Top Sites, Favorites, and Tab Groups with just one click. Set a cool background or ditch the mouse and use the TAB, ↑, ↓, ← and → arrow keys to navigate. Pin the extension icon to the toolbar and you can quickly access anything anytime.
 Features 
🪟 Clean, tiled, Speed Dial-like user interface
✨ Single side panel for quick access to everything
📂 Easy switch between different views, groups and folders
🔎 Quick search across all items
✏️ Create, modify or delete everything in one place
↔️ Drag and drop support (rearrange, organize, pin to desktop)
🔆 Automatic dark/light mode detection
🖼️ Custom wallpapers and wallpaper provider URLs
🌐 Built-in favicon and custom favicon provider support
🎨 Customizable grid layout and color themes
⚡ Lightning fast navigation with TAB and arrow keys
🏳️ Fully localized interface (available in 36 languages)
⚙️ Fine-tuneable permissions. Only allow what you need.
💫 All settings are synced to your browser's account.
📄 Works in Firefox, Chrome, Edge, Opera, Brave, Vivaldi, ...
This is a hobby project for myself, but let's see if it can conquer the world!
Thanks for trying it! ;)
Bug reports, improvement ideas, and pull requests are welcome!

firefox-addons:773227.name: Page Saver WE screenshot capture tool
firefox-addons:773227.summary: Quickly and easily capture an image of a web page. Options allow you to control output format (PNG or JPEG), file name and more.
firefox-addons:773227.description:
Page Saver WE lets you capture images of web pages and save them to a file in PNG or JPEG format, or to the system clipboard. Using Page Saver, you can capture a web page screenshot of an entire page or just the visible portion. To allow you to control the image capture process, a variety of options are provided including a file name pattern and support for an optional header and footer.
To begin using Page Saver WE, click the camera icon on your Firefox toolbar or press Alt+Shift+I (Linux and Windows) or ⌘+Shift+I (macOS).
Please Note: Due to restrictions Firefox imposes on extensions, Page Saver WE cannot capture images of internal Firefox pages such as about:addons or Mozilla hosted pages such as https://addons.mozilla.org/ .
Questions? Contact the developers by sending email to support@pearlcrescent.com

Show password when mouse over password fields.
Show password when mouse over password fields.
Have you ever deleted whole password just because you typed a single letter wrong ?
Now you can get rid of it.
This extension will show you the password in plain text when cursor is over password fields.
You can also change when to show password in options.
Because many people doubt the security of this extension, I upload it's source code to GitHub. https://github.com/a161803398/ShowPassword 
Other mode:
Show password when Double Click.
Show password when On Focus.
Show password when Press Ctrl Key.

apple-macos:6824039967.description:
See where the seller is based before you buy on Amazon.
Shop Stateside adds seller-country badges to supported Amazon.com product listings in Safari. Browse search results, Deals, departments and related products with more information about the seller behind an offer.
• See U.S.-Based Seller and Global Seller badges when seller-country information is available.
• Use saved seller information from the Shop Stateside database to reduce repeated checks.
• Sign in with Apple or your email address.
• Subscribe annually through Apple, restore an existing Apple purchase, or sign in to use eligible existing Shop Stateside access.
• Use the same Shop Stateside account across the Apple apps and supported browser extensions.
• Manage your account, sharing choices and subscription from the app.
SET UP SAFARI
Install the app, sign in, enable Shop Stateside in Safari’s extension settings, and allow access to Amazon and the account services shown during setup. Seller badges require active Shop Stateside access. The download itself is free.
UNDERSTAND THE BADGES
Badges describe the identified seller’s business location. They do not identify where a product was manufactured, guarantee product quality, or certify a seller. Offers and sellers can change. Some listings cannot be verified. Amazon may temporarily limit seller checks; saved information can still be used while direct checks wait to retry.
YOUR CHOICES
Review the seller-sharing options during setup. You can turn off sharing seller-country checks and public seller details. See the privacy policy for information collected, sources, retention and account deletion.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
An annual subscription is available through Apple. Review the current price and renewal terms in the app’s Apple purchase screen. Manage or cancel your Apple subscription in your Apple account subscription settings. Deleting your Shop Stateside account does not cancel an Apple subscription.
Shop Stateside is provided by AMS Digital Ventures LLC and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon.
